# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 28 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 36 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_028_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 28

**1** Jesus said: "I took my stand in the midst of the world, and in flesh I appeared to them.

**2** I found all of them drunk. I found none of them thirsty.

**3** My soul ached for the children of humanity, because they are blind in their hearts and do not see that they have come into the world empty and seek to go out of the world empty.

**4** But now they are drunk. When they shake off their wine, then they will repent."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- "Took my stand" — the deliberate stance; Jesus entered purposefully
- "In flesh I appeared" — the incarnation stated without elaboration
- "Drunk... not thirsty" — the paradox of the worldly condition: sated with the wrong things, unaware of what they lack
- "Ached for" — the empathetic grief of Jesus; rare in Thomas
- "Blind in their hearts" — the heart is the seat of spiritual vision
- "Come into the world empty... go out empty" — the tragic failure of the unawakened life
- "Shake off their wine" — sobriety from worldly intoxication
